observations: Single white dry pressing (non-steam) iron lying on floor tiles.
Body surface is dusty/stained, scuffed with dark marks.
Power cord is visible, long, coiled messily, appears worn/discolored along its length.
At the point where the cord meets the plug, bare twisted wire strands are visible, not properly insulated or secured inside the plug casing.
No brand, model name or rating plate is legible anywhere on the iron body.
No photo shows the iron plugged in, heating, or the sole plate close-up to check for damage or residue.

claims.evidence: No photo or video shows the iron plugged in, heating, or in use; claim rests on seller's word only.

claims.claim: Implied safe/usable condition (by listing it for sale as-is)
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows exposed bare wire strands at the cord-plug junction, a visible safety defect.

risks.risk: Iron may not heat at all (element or thermostat fault)
risks.proof: Short video of the iron plugged in with the indicator light on and sole plate warming, or a photo of steam/heat test on cloth

risks.risk: Exposed wiring at plug is a shock/fire hazard and may need rewiring before safe use
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the plug after proper rewiring/insulation, or confirmation from seller with new plug fitted
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing repair, deducted as a faulty/unsafe unit

risks.risk: Sole plate condition (scratches, residue, non-stick coating wear) cannot be judged from this angle
risks.proof: Clear photo of the flat ironing surface (sole plate) from underneath
risks.if_unproven: priced as average/unknown wear, not premium condition

risks.risk: No brand/model visible, so no way to judge build quality tier or genuine parts
risks.proof: Photo of any brand label or embossed logo on the top or base

proof_requests: Video of the iron plugged in and heating up (indicator light, warmth on sole plate)
Close-up photo of the sole plate (bottom ironing surface)
Close-up photo of the plug and cord junction after any repair, showing no exposed wire
Any photo showing a brand label or model marking
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a generic dry pressing iron, but the 'still working' claim is unverified and the visible exposed wiring is a real safety defect, so per the rules it must be priced at worst case as a non-working/unsafe unit until heating and repaired-cord proof is given.
